title: Going to “the beach” except it’s never really a beach?
content: Hi, I’m new here :) but an avid vivid dreamer my whole life. I can remember dreams I’ve had as young as real-life memories and I used to lucid dream unintentionally before I ever knew of the concept (wish I could still do that easily!) Often, I dream in different “beach” environments. I’ve visited each of them multiple times over the years. In my dream I always think of these places as beaches, but they’re not really beaches by definition. Have you ever been? 1. Artificial beach right next to a car garage. This one is interesting because for the first time recently, I dreamt that someone came out of the garage and turned off all the waves with a remote control, and then a tarp appeared over the water. I got into a fight with this guy ‘cause he really didn’t want me at his beach, apparently. There’s sand, the water is turquoise blue, there are grassy bushes, the coast is rounded, but direct access to the water is very limited because it’s mainly surrounded by the grassy bushes and trees. When you happen upon it it’s like you stepped into a photo frame. I feel so locked in when I look out at the water. The feeling on land is generally very peaceful but the water has a menacing vibe to it. Probably because it’s an artificial ocean being controlled by some guy in a car garage lmao. 2. A huge brick building with a “beach” inside, except the beach is like an aquarium pool with cement walkways and pipes sticking out everywhere. There are usually lots of people in the water behaving as if they’re enjoying an actual beach. There are even dolphins jumping around in the corner of the building. I’m always too skittish to get in the water but I spend a lot of the dream really excited to be here and walking around trying to balance on the decaying cement beams over the pool lol 3. Cement beach hut. There are tons of people around and the place is kind of junky. This is most similar to an actual public beach. I’m never near the water, but I can look out between the beams of the cement hut and watch the waves in the distance. I’m usually here around sunset and the vibe is very chaotic. Sometimes I’m there at night and it’s completely empty and I get a little distressed trying to think of which direction to go so that I can get home. The hut is similar to where beach showers would typically be and there’s sometimes water dripping from the ceiling These are the mains! Would love to know if you’ve seen these places or if you have a similar experience of your mind experiencing a location as one thing, but that actual location being something different.
